capabilities: Route pasted files into per-folder asset folders via folder rules
Name saved files with a rule-based pattern that never overwrites
Browse and filter saved assets in a grid or list per folder rule
Rename or move single or many files while keeping links working
Export and import folder rules and presets as JSON
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.4 or newer; on mobile it needs the 'Automatically update internal links' setting enabled and rules synced via .obsidian. Android has only been tested in an emulator and iOS is untested. Rules are stored in the plugin's data.json inside the vault, so sync setups that skip .obsidian will lose them on other devices.
intentEvidence: Foldwise handles these too: once the note you are editing links to the photo, it moves and renames the photo with the same rules.
problem: Obsidian saves pasted and attached files using one global setting, with no per-folder rules and no central place to browse, rename or move saved assets.
summary: Rule-based attachment router that saves pasted files into per-folder asset folders and manages all saved files from one page.
